title: docs: add hosted MCP guide
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Extends the existing MCP guide with the hosted catalog and direct external-client setup
- Documents Streamable HTTP, bearer authentication, SDK connection, and Pollen billing
- Condenses tool, deployment, and reference sections without removing core capabilities

gist.headline: MCP, now less archaeological
gist.blurb: The MCP guide now maps the hosted catalog and the path in from external clients. Bring a bearer token; the tools are already awake.
gist.summary: Expanded the MCP README with hosted catalog discovery, Streamable HTTP and bearer-auth setup, SDK connection examples, and Pollen billing guidance while consolidating deployment and tool references.
gist.impact: Developers can connect external MCP clients to Pollinations' hosted tools with clearer authentication, transport, SDK, and billing instructions instead of excavating the setup from scattered sections.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a tiny guide with a map and explorer hat, leading the eager CRT Monitor Robot from an external laptop through a friendly garden gate labeled MCP toward a cozy hosted-tool catalog terminal. Streamable HTTP is represented by a gentle glowing river or pipeline connecting the client and catalog, with a small bearer-token key and Pollen flowers growing nearby.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art garden guide scene: Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and a tiny explorer hat, points at a hosted MCP catalog terminal while a cheerful CRT-monitor robot connects an external laptop through a glowing Streamable HTTP path; a small bearer-token key and Pollen flowers sit beside the route. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, subtle CRT glow, pixel-font text: "MCP GUIDE", retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
